name: @activepieces/piece-canny
description: Product feedback management platform. Collect, organize, and prioritize feature requests from your users.

auth.description: Your Canny secret API key. Find it at Settings → API in your Canny admin dashboard.

create_post.name: create_post
create_post.description: Creates a new post on a Canny board.

auth.description: Your Canny secret API key. Find it at Settings → API in your Canny admin dashboard.

authorID.description: The unique identifier of the post author (Canny user ID).

title.description: A brief title describing the post.

details.description: The longer description of the post.

byID.description: The unique identifier of the admin creating the post on behalf of the author.

categoryID.description: The unique identifier of the category to assign.

ownerID.description: The unique identifier of the user responsible for completing the work.

eta.description: The estimated delivery date in MM/YYYY format (e.g. "06/2026").

etaPublic.description: Whether the ETA should be visible to all users.

customFields.description: Custom fields as key-value pairs (keys max 30 chars, values max 200 chars).

createdAt.description: Original creation date in ISO 8601 format, for migrating posts from another source.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new feedback post (feature request, bug, etc.) on a Canny board. Use to submit feedback captured elsewhere into Canny. Requires a board ID, an author Canny user ID, a title, and details; creates a distinct post on each call (not idempotent).

retrieve_post.name: retrieve_post
retrieve_post.description: Retrieves the details of an existing post by its ID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the post.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single Canny post by its unique post ID and returns its full details. Use when you already have a post ID and need its current data (status, score, author, board). Read-only and idempotent.

list_posts.name: list_posts
list_posts.description: Returns a list of posts for a board, with optional filtering and sorting.

auth.description: Your Canny secret API key. Find it at Settings → API in your Canny admin dashboard.

boardID.description: The board to list posts for (optional — omit to list across all boards).

search.description: A search query to filter posts.

status.description: Comma-separated list of statuses to filter by (e.g. "open,planned").

skip.description: Number of posts to skip (for pagination).

aiMetadata.description: Lists Canny posts, optionally scoped to one board or queried across all boards when no board is given, with optional search text, status filter, sort order, and pagination (limit/skip). Use to discover or search posts rather than fetch one known post by ID. Read-only and idempotent.

create_vote.name: create_vote
create_vote.description: Casts a vote on a post on behalf of a user.

postID.description: The unique identifier of the post to vote on.

voterID.description: The unique identifier of the voter (Canny user ID).

aiMetadata.description: Registers a vote on a Canny post on behalf of a specific user. Use to record support for a feature request when acting as that voter. Requires the post ID and the voter Canny user ID. Effectively idempotent: re-voting the same user on the same post does not add duplicate votes.

delete_vote.name: delete_vote
delete_vote.description: Removes a vote from a post for a given user.

postID.description: The unique identifier of the post to remove the vote from.

voterID.description: The unique identifier of the voter (Canny user ID).

aiMetadata.description: Removes a specific user's vote from a Canny post. Use to retract support previously registered for a post. Requires the post ID and the voter Canny user ID. Idempotent: removing an already-absent vote leaves the post in the same state.

new_post.name: new_post
new_post.description: Triggers when a new post is created on a Canny board.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new feedback post is created on any Canny board, delivering the post with its board and author. Use to react to incoming feature requests or feedback as they are submitted.

object.title: Sample feature request
object.details: It would be great if the app had dark mode.

post_status_changed.name: post_status_changed
post_status_changed.description: Triggers when a post's status is changed (e.g. open → in progress → complete).

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a Canny post moves to a different status (for example open to in progress to complete), delivering the post in its new state. Use to react to changes in how a feature request is progressing.

object.title: Sample feature request
object.details: It would be great if the app had dark mode.

new_comment.name: new_comment
new_comment.description: Triggers when a new comment is created on a post.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new comment is added to any Canny post, delivering the comment along with its author and parent post. Use to react to discussion activity on feedback.

object.value: This is a great idea! We really need this feature.

new_vote.name: new_vote
new_vote.description: Triggers when a user votes on a post.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a user casts a vote on a Canny post, delivering the vote with its voter and the parent post. Use to react to changes in demand or support for feedback.

post.title: Sample feature request
post.details: It would be great if the app had dark mode.
